Blended Intensive Programme „Creating Art and Heritage Incubators that Matter: From Idea to Impact” organized in Plovdiv by DA Tsenov Academy of Economics

This two-journey session, organized within the KreativEU University Alliance, invites interdisciplinary contributions that critically explore the relationship between heritage and imagination. In line with European cultural heritage policies emphasizing participation, social cohesion, sustainability, and innovation, the session seeks to examine how heritage practices, narratives, and governance frameworks support future-oriented thinking and inclusive development.

Convened under the patronage of the KreativEU Alliance of European Universities and co-financed by the European Union, the event will assemble eminent voices from eco-cultural heritage, conservation sciences, history, archaeology, and cognate fields. Its purpose is to advance critical discourse and to shape evidence-based strategies for the sustainable stewardship of our shared cultural legacy.
